67b6d34d6f289a31d8f832d7.subject: External Exam Information
67b6d34d6f289a31d8f832d7.content:
Dear Parent

At VIBGYOR we encourage students who are scholastically inclined to appear for examinations which tests the students logical, verbal, and analytical skills through an initiative called External Exams. This enables learners to register for multiple Olympiads and competitive examinations conducted at the state, national, and international levels.

The examinations being offered to our learners for the Academic Year 2026-27 are:

 

 

National Olympiad Foundation (NOF)

The National Olympiad Foundation (NOF) provides interactive, gamified, and animation-based examinations. Through this collaboration, we aim at building a strong positive attitude in our learners and encourage application-based learning in English, Mathematics, and Science. Learners also develop logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

The post-examination reports identify an individual’s learning gaps and fill those gaps through the algorithmically generated analysis report and remedial plans.

 

SPELLBEE Global London (NOF)

 

SPELLBEE GLOBAL is a UK-based organisation that conducts the world's largest Spell Bee competitions based on pedagogical skills and eloquent linguistic abilities. It is a language test that aims to assess one's vocabulary and linguistic skills based on the efficient use of grammar, reading, listening, and comprehension, speaking, and writing abilities.

 

 

 

LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP)

 

The LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP) is an innovative educational initiative designed to develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and reasoning skills in learners. By integrating engaging and challenging puzzles, activities, and exercises, the programme aims to foster a deeper understanding of logical and analytical thinking.

The programme is broken down into 3 stages:

Practice

First Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

Final Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE)

The National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE) is a diagnostic test which helps learners improve their critical thinking unlike regular tests that focus only on how much a child knows (or has memorised). The NSTSE provides detailed skill-wise feedback highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each learner and measures how well they have understood the concepts.

Structure: 60-minute, objective-type, multiple-choice questions

 

Science Olympiad Foundation (SOF)

SOF is a New Delhi-based, non-profit educational organisation established in 1998 to promote Science, Math, English, Computer education, and General knowledge among the learnerof grades 1 to 12. It organises the world's largest Olympiads, with over 99,499 schools and millions of participants across 72+ countries.

Format: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs), typically 60 minutes long, conducted in English.

Levels: Most major exams (NSO, IMO, IEO) have two levels, while others are single level.

 

SpellBee International

SpellBee International is a comprehensive English language development programme and competition for learners of grades 1–12. It uses research-backed, grade-specific preparatory books to teach vocabulary, grammar, phonetics, and comprehension through 15 standardised rounds. Beyond just spelling, it covers vocabulary, phonetics, word roots, and reading comprehension.

SpellBee International is a trailblazing educational research organisation that has revolutionised English language education for over 15 years, serving more than 6000 schools and certifying over 10,00,000 learners.

Levels: Features four levels of competition (School, Inter-School, State, and National)

Resources: Provides extensive preparatory materials, including books, apps, and live webinars.

 

 

 

Green Olympiad

The GREEN Olympiad is a leading school-based initiative of TERI. TERI is known for its sustainability transformation that matches the aspirations of the academic community. It has established itself as an Environment Education brand. Reaching out to nearly 2000 schools annually in India and abroad, this Olympiad is designed for learners of grades 4 to 12.

Duration: 60 minutes

Number of Questions: 50 (No negative marking)

Dear Parent 

Competitive examinations offer an intellectual challenge to children during their formative years of learning. A few competitive examinations have been developed for our learners/students after a detailed analysis of syllabi across diverse educational boards. 

The examinations being offered to our learners/students for the Academic Year                are: 

National Olympiad Foundation (NOF) 

We have collaborated with the National Olympiad Foundation (NOF) which provides an interactive, gamified, and animation based International Olympiad examination. Through this collaboration, we aim at building a strong positive attitude in our learners/students and encouraging application-based learning in English, Mathematics, and Science. The questions are interactive with voice support which means learners/students can touch the cartoons, and other elements on the screen, and read and listen to the question as well. Learners/students can also develop logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving skills. These exams are unique due to their easy and fun-filled approach towards the subjects which is completely different from the traditional learning and understanding of concepts.

67b6d34d6f289a31d8f832d7.content:
Dear Parent

At VIBGYOR we encourage students who are scholastically inclined to appear for examinations which tests the students logical, verbal, and analytical skills through an initiative called External Exams. This enables learners to register for multiple Olympiads and competitive examinations conducted at the state, national, and international levels.

The examinations being offered to our learners for the Academic Year 2026-27 are:

 

 

National Olympiad Foundation (NOF)

The National Olympiad Foundation (NOF) provides interactive, gamified, and animation-based examinations. Through this collaboration, we aim at building a strong positive attitude in our learners and encourage application-based learning in English, Mathematics, and Science. Learners also develop logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

The post-examination reports identify an individual’s learning gaps and fill those gaps through the algorithmically generated analysis report and remedial plans.

 

SPELLBEE Global London (NOF)

 

SPELLBEE GLOBAL is a UK-based organisation that conducts the world's largest Spell Bee competitions based on pedagogical skills and eloquent linguistic abilities. It is a language test that aims to assess one's vocabulary and linguistic skills based on the efficient use of grammar, reading, listening, and comprehension, speaking, and writing abilities.

 

 

 

LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP)

 

The LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP) is an innovative educational initiative designed to develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and reasoning skills in learners. By integrating engaging and challenging puzzles, activities, and exercises, the programme aims to foster a deeper understanding of logical and analytical thinking.

The programme is broken down into 3 stages:

Practice

First Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

Final Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE)

The National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE) is a diagnostic test which helps learners improve their critical thinking unlike regular tests that focus only on how much a child knows (or has memorised). The NSTSE provides detailed skill-wise feedback highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each learner and measures how well they have understood the concepts.

Structure: 60-minute, objective-type, multiple-choice questions

 

Science Olympiad Foundation (SOF)

SOF is a New Delhi-based, non-profit educational organisation established in 1998 to promote Science, Math, English, Computer education, and General knowledge among the learnerof grades 1 to 12. It organises the world's largest Olympiads, with over 99,499 schools and millions of participants across 72+ countries.

Format: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs), typically 60 minutes long, conducted in English.

Levels: Most major exams (NSO, IMO, IEO) have two levels, while others are single level.

 

SpellBee International

SpellBee International is a comprehensive English language development programme and competition for learners of grades 1–12. It uses research-backed, grade-specific preparatory books to teach vocabulary, grammar, phonetics, and comprehension through 15 standardised rounds. Beyond just spelling, it covers vocabulary, phonetics, word roots, and reading comprehension.

SpellBee International is a trailblazing educational research organisation that has revolutionised English language education for over 15 years, serving more than 6000 schools and certifying over 10,00,000 learners.

Levels: Features four levels of competition (School, Inter-School, State, and National)

Resources: Provides extensive preparatory materials, including books, apps, and live webinars.

 

 

 

Green Olympiad

The GREEN Olympiad is a leading school-based initiative of TERI. TERI is known for its sustainability transformation that matches the aspirations of the academic community. It has established itself as an Environment Education brand. Reaching out to nearly 2000 schools annually in India and abroad, this Olympiad is designed for learners of grades 4 to 12.

Duration: 60 minutes

Number of Questions: 50 (No negative marking)

67b6d34d6f289a31d8f832d7.subject: External Exam Information
67b6d34d6f289a31d8f832d7.content:
Dear Parent

At VIBGYOR we encourage students who are scholastically inclined to appear for examinations which tests the students logical, verbal, and analytical skills through an initiative called External Exams. This enables learners to register for multiple Olympiads and competitive examinations conducted at the state, national, and international levels.

The examinations being offered to our learners for the Academic Year 2026-27 are:

 

 

National Olympiad Foundation (NOF)

The National Olympiad Foundation (NOF) provides interactive, gamified, and animation-based examinations. Through this collaboration, we aim at building a strong positive attitude in our learners and encourage application-based learning in English, Mathematics, and Science. Learners also develop logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

The post-examination reports identify an individual’s learning gaps and fill those gaps through the algorithmically generated analysis report and remedial plans.

 

SPELLBEE Global London (NOF)

 

SPELLBEE GLOBAL is a UK-based organisation that conducts the world's largest Spell Bee competitions based on pedagogical skills and eloquent linguistic abilities. It is a language test that aims to assess one's vocabulary and linguistic skills based on the efficient use of grammar, reading, listening, and comprehension, speaking, and writing abilities.

 

 

 

LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP)

 

The LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP) is an innovative educational initiative designed to develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and reasoning skills in learners. By integrating engaging and challenging puzzles, activities, and exercises, the programme aims to foster a deeper understanding of logical and analytical thinking.

The programme is broken down into 3 stages:

Practice

First Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

Final Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE)

The National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE) is a diagnostic test which helps learners improve their critical thinking unlike regular tests that focus only on how much a child knows (or has memorised). The NSTSE provides detailed skill-wise feedback highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each learner and measures how well they have understood the concepts.

Structure: 60-minute, objective-type, multiple-choice questions

 

Science Olympiad Foundation (SOF)

SOF is a New Delhi-based, non-profit educational organisation established in 1998 to promote Science, Math, English, Computer education, and General knowledge among the learnerof grades 1 to 12. It organises the world's largest Olympiads, with over 99,499 schools and millions of participants across 72+ countries.

Format: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs), typically 60 minutes long, conducted in English.

Levels: Most major exams (NSO, IMO, IEO) have two levels, while others are single level.

 

SpellBee International

SpellBee International is a comprehensive English language development programme and competition for learners of grades 1–12. It uses research-backed, grade-specific preparatory books to teach vocabulary, grammar, phonetics, and comprehension through 15 standardised rounds. Beyond just spelling, it covers vocabulary, phonetics, word roots, and reading comprehension.

SpellBee International is a trailblazing educational research organisation that has revolutionised English language education for over 15 years, serving more than 6000 schools and certifying over 10,00,000 learners.

Levels: Features four levels of competition (School, Inter-School, State, and National)

Resources: Provides extensive preparatory materials, including books, apps, and live webinars.

 

 

 

Green Olympiad

The GREEN Olympiad is a leading school-based initiative of TERI. TERI is known for its sustainability transformation that matches the aspirations of the academic community. It has established itself as an Environment Education brand. Reaching out to nearly 2000 schools annually in India and abroad, this Olympiad is designed for learners of grades 4 to 12.

Duration: 60 minutes

Number of Questions: 50 (No negative marking)

The examinations being offered to our learners for the Academic Year 2026-27 are:

 

 

National Olympiad Foundation (NOF)

The National Olympiad Foundation (NOF) provides interactive, gamified, and animation-based examinations. Through this collaboration, we aim at building a strong positive attitude in our learners and encourage application-based learning in English, Mathematics, and Science. Learners also develop logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

The post-examination reports identify an individual’s learning gaps and fill those gaps through the algorithmically generated analysis report and remedial plans.

 

SPELLBEE Global London (NOF)

 

SPELLBEE GLOBAL is a UK-based organisation that conducts the world's largest Spell Bee competitions based on pedagogical skills and eloquent linguistic abilities. It is a language test that aims to assess one's vocabulary and linguistic skills based on the efficient use of grammar, reading, listening, and comprehension, speaking, and writing abilities.

 

 

 

LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP)

 

The LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP) is an innovative educational initiative designed to develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and reasoning skills in learners. By integrating engaging and challenging puzzles, activities, and exercises, the programme aims to foster a deeper understanding of logical and analytical thinking.

The programme is broken down into 3 stages:

Practice

First Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

Final Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE)

The National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE) is a diagnostic test which helps learners improve their critical thinking unlike regular tests that focus only on how much a child knows (or has memorised). The NSTSE provides detailed skill-wise feedback highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each learner and measures how well they have understood the concepts.

Structure: 60-minute, objective-type, multiple-choice questions

 

Science Olympiad Foundation (SOF)

SOF is a New Delhi-based, non-profit educational organisation established in 1998 to promote Science, Math, English, Computer education, and General knowledge among the learnerof grades 1 to 12. It organises the world's largest Olympiads, with over 99,499 schools and millions of participants across 72+ countries.

Format: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs), typically 60 minutes long, conducted in English.

Levels: Most major exams (NSO, IMO, IEO) have two levels, while others are single level.

 

SpellBee International

SpellBee International is a comprehensive English language development programme and competition for learners of grades 1–12. It uses research-backed, grade-specific preparatory books to teach vocabulary, grammar, phonetics, and comprehension through 15 standardised rounds. Beyond just spelling, it covers vocabulary, phonetics, word roots, and reading comprehension.

SpellBee International is a trailblazing educational research organisation that has revolutionised English language education for over 15 years, serving more than 6000 schools and certifying over 10,00,000 learners.

Levels: Features four levels of competition (School, Inter-School, State, and National)

Resources: Provides extensive preparatory materials, including books, apps, and live webinars.

 

 

 

Green Olympiad

The GREEN Olympiad is a leading school-based initiative of TERI. TERI is known for its sustainability transformation that matches the aspirations of the academic community. It has established itself as an Environment Education brand. Reaching out to nearly 2000 schools annually in India and abroad, this Olympiad is designed for learners of grades 4 to 12.

Duration: 60 minutes

Number of Questions: 50 (No negative marking)

67b6d34d6f289a31d8f832d7.content:
Dear Parent

At VIBGYOR we encourage students who are scholastically inclined to appear for examinations which tests the students logical, verbal, and analytical skills through an initiative called External Exams. This enables learners to register for multiple Olympiads and competitive examinations conducted at the state, national, and international levels.

The examinations being offered to our learners for the Academic Year 2026-27 are:

 

 

National Olympiad Foundation (NOF)

The National Olympiad Foundation (NOF) provides interactive, gamified, and animation-based examinations. Through this collaboration, we aim at building a strong positive attitude in our learners and encourage application-based learning in English, Mathematics, and Science. Learners also develop logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

The post-examination reports identify an individual’s learning gaps and fill those gaps through the algorithmically generated analysis report and remedial plans.

 

SPELLBEE Global London (NOF)

 

SPELLBEE GLOBAL is a UK-based organisation that conducts the world's largest Spell Bee competitions based on pedagogical skills and eloquent linguistic abilities. It is a language test that aims to assess one's vocabulary and linguistic skills based on the efficient use of grammar, reading, listening, and comprehension, speaking, and writing abilities.

 

 

 

LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP)

 

The LogiQids Mental Aptitude Programme (LMAP) is an innovative educational initiative designed to develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and reasoning skills in learners. By integrating engaging and challenging puzzles, activities, and exercises, the programme aims to foster a deeper understanding of logical and analytical thinking.

The programme is broken down into 3 stages:

Practice

First Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

Final Stage Logical Reasoning Olympiad

National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE)

The National Level Science Talent Search Examination (NSTSE) is a diagnostic test which helps learners improve their critical thinking unlike regular tests that focus only on how much a child knows (or has memorised). The NSTSE provides detailed skill-wise feedback highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of each learner and measures how well they have understood the concepts.

Structure: 60-minute, objective-type, multiple-choice questions

 

Science Olympiad Foundation (SOF)

SOF is a New Delhi-based, non-profit educational organisation established in 1998 to promote Science, Math, English, Computer education, and General knowledge among the learnerof grades 1 to 12. It organises the world's largest Olympiads, with over 99,499 schools and millions of participants across 72+ countries.

Format: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs), typically 60 minutes long, conducted in English.

Levels: Most major exams (NSO, IMO, IEO) have two levels, while others are single level.

 

SpellBee International

SpellBee International is a comprehensive English language development programme and competition for learners of grades 1–12. It uses research-backed, grade-specific preparatory books to teach vocabulary, grammar, phonetics, and comprehension through 15 standardised rounds. Beyond just spelling, it covers vocabulary, phonetics, word roots, and reading comprehension.

SpellBee International is a trailblazing educational research organisation that has revolutionised English language education for over 15 years, serving more than 6000 schools and certifying over 10,00,000 learners.

Levels: Features four levels of competition (School, Inter-School, State, and National)

Resources: Provides extensive preparatory materials, including books, apps, and live webinars.

 

 

 

Green Olympiad

The GREEN Olympiad is a leading school-based initiative of TERI. TERI is known for its sustainability transformation that matches the aspirations of the academic community. It has established itself as an Environment Education brand. Reaching out to nearly 2000 schools annually in India and abroad, this Olympiad is designed for learners of grades 4 to 12.

Duration: 60 minutes

Number of Questions: 50 (No negative marking)
